repository_audit.question: separate staging project reference without secret-value access
repository_audit.evidence: scripts/supabase-migration-selector.js contains distinct STAGING and PRODUCTION contracts, project references, database identities and environment-key names

repository_audit.question: environment separation
repository_audit.evidence: selector validates environment, project reference, database identity, owner and ledger fingerprint independently for STAGING and PRODUCTION
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: future preflight must bind all identities and prohibit fallback

repository_audit.question: declared staging roles
repository_audit.evidence: staging migrations declare retailer_catalogue_staging_validator, retailer_catalogue_staging_approver and retailer_catalogue_staging_executor
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: role names do not prove current deployment or suitability

repository_audit.question: existing metadata-only role
repository_audit.evidence: no deployed-contract role is limited to the proposed identity, ledger and catalogue-metadata allowlist

repository_audit.question: existing validator or exporter privilege breadth
repository_audit.evidence: the staging validator can execute validation and control-plan registration interfaces; production-role-session exposes general client.query; service_role, approver and executor have mutation capability
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: none may be reused as the preflight credential

repository_audit.question: safe project and retailer identity RPC
repository_audit.evidence: the prepared control-state RPC validates a supplied retailer but does not attest control-plane project identity or expose a metadata-only retailer lookup

repository_audit.question: migration ledger without general SQL
repository_audit.evidence: selector and verifier query supabase_migrations.schema_migrations through an owner database URL and general PostgreSQL client

repository_audit.question: schema, function, role, ACL and RLS metadata without broad credential
repository_audit.evidence: repository tests inspect these catalogs locally, but no deployed bounded staging RPC exposes the exact proposed projection

repository_audit.question: existing provider or CLI for this preflight
repository_audit.evidence: selected-migration tooling uses owner credentials and direct SQL; control-state live provider is intentionally unwired and limited to one different RPC

repository_audit.question: mutation paths in existing tools
repository_audit.evidence: apply-selected-migrations, approver, executor, service-role and retailer refresh surfaces can mutate state
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: exclude their modules, credentials and roles from preflight dependency closure

repository_audit.question: smallest missing capability
repository_audit.evidence: one future static metadata RPC can aggregate the database allowlist in one statement; a separate staging-only login can receive EXECUTE only
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: implementation and deployment require separate reviewed work and authorization

repository_audit.question: production misdirection risk
repository_audit.evidence: shared tooling supports both environments and protected URLs are external inputs
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: require exact host and project allowlists plus independent database-target attestation; no fallback

repository_audit.question: safe retailer ID resolution
repository_audit.evidence: an exact name-or-slug lookup can return only id, name and slug with uniqueness enforcement
repository_audit.safety_conclusion: do not copy or guess a production or historical ID

repository_audit.question: approved evidence store
repository_audit.evidence: retention policy R is approved, but the repository names no current private store with encryption, immutability, audit and readback proof

query_allowlist.purpose: attest the exact staging project and exclude production

query_allowlist.purpose: resolve one unique staging retailer ID for 10 Reps

query_allowlist.expected_result: exactly one row matching the approved 10 Reps name or slug
query_allowlist.redaction: exclude all retailer configuration, credentials, URLs and unrelated retailer rows

query_allowlist.purpose: classify the exact RA-004 migration ledger state
query_allowlist.expected_result: target absent with an attested current ledger, or one exact target entry; duplicates and unknown ledger states fail
query_allowlist.redaction: return no migration body, database URL or unrelated ledger rows
query_allowlist.stop_condition: unknown fingerprint, duplicate target, unexpected target name or partial-state conflict

query_allowlist.purpose: verify prerequisites and target objects without reading business rows
query_allowlist.exact_source: future read_ra004_staging_preflight_v1 closed pg_catalog and to_regclass/to_regprocedure projection
query_allowlist.expected_result: every prerequisite has its exact expected state and target objects are wholly absent or wholly present
query_allowlist.redaction: only predeclared RA-004 prerequisite and target object names
query_allowlist.stop_condition: missing prerequisite, partial target state, unknown object or extra returned row

query_allowlist.purpose: verify exact function signatures, ownership and safe properties
query_allowlist.exact_source: future read_ra004_staging_preflight_v1 closed pg_proc, pg_namespace and pg_roles projection
query_allowlist.expected_result: only approved prerequisite and RA-004 signatures with expected owners and properties
query_allowlist.redaction: return definition digest, never unrestricted function bodies
query_allowlist.stop_condition: signature, owner, security mode, search path or digest mismatch

query_allowlist.purpose: verify exact role attributes and membership edges
query_allowlist.exact_source: future read_ra004_staging_preflight_v1 closed pg_roles and pg_auth_members projection
query_allowlist.expected_result: closed role set with no privilege or SET ROLE escalation path
query_allowlist.redaction: no password hashes, connection strings, settings outside the approved role set or unrelated roles
query_allowlist.stop_condition: unknown role, broad attribute, login mismatch or forbidden membership/SET edge

query_allowlist.purpose: verify RA-004 ownership, ACL and RLS boundaries
query_allowlist.exact_source: future read_ra004_staging_preflight_v1 closed pg_class, pg_namespace, pg_policy and ACL expansion projection
query_allowlist.expected_result: exact approved grants and policies only, with no PUBLIC, service_role, validator, approver or executor access to the preflight interface
query_allowlist.redaction: only predeclared RA-004 objects, roles and normalized privileges
query_allowlist.stop_condition: broad grant, missing forced RLS, unexpected owner/policy or result above cap

query_allowlist.purpose: attest the private evidence destination before any database connection
query_allowlist.exact_source: future owner-approved signed evidence-store configuration record
query_allowlist.expected_result: one private store matching approved retention policy R and supporting redacted write-once evidence plus readback
query_allowlist.redaction: no endpoint credential, token, object contents or unrelated store inventory
query_allowlist.stop_condition: missing approval, public access, missing encryption/audit/immutability/readback or retention mismatch
